name: Seirei Choukoushi
source:
A country where star spirits live in hiding--the Kingdom of Orclesia.

In a perfume workshop in a corner of the royal capital of Batrea, a girl lived with a star spirit. The scents she created with the help of star spirits had a healing power.

However, due to the flow of time, the existence of star spirits was forgotten by people.

Still, one day when she was aiming to become a full-fledged perfumer, she devoted herself to her studies. By chance, she met the captain of the Kingdom's knights.

He said to her, "I want you to be my exclusive perfumer"...?

Before long, the girl becomes embroiled in the conspiracy of the royal palace over the Star Spirits.

[Translated from [url=http://comodo.starfree.jp/perfumer/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
星灵隐居于一个名为Orclesia的国度。

在王都Batrea一隅的香水工坊里，一个女孩与一位星灵相依为伴。她借助星灵制作的香氛具有疗愈之力。

然而随着时间流逝，人们渐渐遗忘了星灵的存在。

即便如此，她仍埋头学习，立志成为独当一面的调香师。某天，她偶然遇见了王国骑士团团长。

“我想聘请你成为我的专属调香师。”他对她说道……？

不久之后，女孩卷入了王宫围绕星灵展开的阴谋。

[译自：[url=http://comodo.starfree.jp/perfumer/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
